runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
The passages do not state any fine or monetary penalty that OMB M-25-21 sets for missing an AI strategy deadline, so I can't answer that part from the documents.

The closest M-25-21 material concerns compliance plans. Agencies must submit a plan, or a written determination that they do not use covered AI, within a set window (within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036). The passages also say nothing about what happens if that deadline is missed.

The "AI strategy" deadline appears in a different memo, OMB M-24-10. Its consolidated table says CFO Act agencies must develop and release publicly an agency strategy for removing barriers to the use of AI and advancing agency AI maturity within 365 days. The passages do not say whether M-25-21 changes or replaces that requirement.

The only consequence the passages describe is operational, not financial. Under M-24-10, agencies must apply minimum practices to safety-impacting and rights-impacting AI by December 1, 2024, or else stop using the AI until they achieve compliance. That provision is in M-24-10, not M-25-21.

citations.cited_text: Consistent with Section 104( c) and ( d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AL Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.23 0MB will provide templates for these compliance plans.
